name.zh: L 撑到 V 撑画圈

purpose.zh: 撑住身体，练双腿画圈抬高的控制
purpose.en: Stay up on your hands and control your legs as they circle up high.

text.zh: 撑住不落地，双腿向外打开再往上画圈
text.en: Stay up on your hands, open your legs wide, then sweep them up in a circle
Press your shoulders down and keep your arms straight.

text.zh: 每圈换一次方向，画得慢而稳。
text.en: Switch direction each circle and move slowly and steadily.

commonErrors.en: Circling too fast and losing control.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时先活动一下手腕
cautions.en: If your wrists feel stiff, warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼时少做一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your wrists or shoulders hurt, do less, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 节奏按 spec（10 s 循环两圈、方向相反）：打开+抬到V 1.9 s / 放回L撑 1.0 s / 停 2.1 s；kind=rep_cycle
end 口令「换方向」改「放回来」（换方向在两圈之间，不是每圈的结尾）
剂量 2 → 4 圈（两个方向各 2）
flags: 批表换用 feet 轨（go 0.53/rest 3.45）不可信，按 spec 手算；每圈之后停约 1 s，循环接缝处再多停 1.2 s，rest 取平均
